enforcement.previously: the 35 h per-identity ceiling and the storage gate existed only as constants and helper functions with no call site in the execution path, so neither could have halted anything. Nothing summed GPU hours across cells.
enforcement.now: run.per_identity_gate reads an append-only ledger (gpu_hour_ledger.json) and is checked BEFORE every core cell against that cell's projected cost, then re-checked AFTER the cell against its MEASURED hours, which are charged to the ledger. run.storage_gate is checked before every cell. Both halt through gate_halt.
enforcement.verified: the executable gate reproduces the published 34.517 h to within rounding, and it RESERVES the cells that have not run yet -- charging each the greater of its projected and its actual cost -- so a rate overrun is detected on the first cell that shows it rather than after most of the arm is burned.

e8b_identity_reconciliation.summary_of_change: the pretrained identity projects to 34.517 h against a 35.0 h ceiling (0.483 h headroom). That is a rise of 1.831 h from the original 32.686 h. 5 separate omissions were found and corrected across seven review rounds, every one of them raising the total; the measurement phase then raised it again. The one reduction in the whole history was removing the selection-sensitivity study, whose object the fixed-endpoint rule eliminated, and it is disclosed and costed separately.
e8b_identity_reconciliation.verdict: UNDER THE CEILING BUT NOT CLEARED TO RUN. The complete MEASURED programme projects to 34.517 h against the hard 35.0 h ceiling, leaving 0.483 h. That is below the 1.0 GPU-hour headroom floor the user set, so execution STOPS and returns to the user rather than starting training. This is NOT a pass: a projection that clears a hard ceiling by under half an hour, on a programme whose estimate has moved repeatedly, is not a margin worth committing six cells to. Both optimisations were proven EXACT and are adopted; the ceiling was not raised and no scientific condition, denominator or metric was removed.
